entries.0660eaa598cddc8b: In its long-term vision and medium-term management plan announced in 2024, with group synergies from business integration as the source, it lists increasing ARR in the SaaS business and expanding existing businesses as key measures. The pillar of its medium- to long-term strategy is inorganic growth through M&A; by creating synergies within the group, it aims to accelerate business growth and expand its business domains. As key KPIs, it adopts three: the inventory balance in the Life Platform Business, the number of companies adopting products in the SaaS business, and the EBITDA growth rate.
entries.0a250961cc3c8ecc: The company was established on April 1, 2024, as a pure holding company and full parent of Tasuki Co., Ltd. and Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd. through a joint share transfer, and manages the group as a whole. The group consists of the company and 6 subsidiaries (of which ZISEDAI Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. are unconsolidated subsidiaries), and operates the Life Platform Business, the Finance Consulting Business and the SaaS Business (unconsolidated).

entries.189981c6d10847b4: A holding company group whose core is the Life Platform Business, which plans, develops and sells newly built IoT residences for investment, centered on Tokyo's 23 wards.
entries.1ae1999ac7877d02: This business is carried out by Tasuki Co., Ltd., Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd., Aura Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. (unconsolidated).
entries.217ec5a0d8b4d660: New-build investment IoT residences are located within the 23 wards of Tokyo and within a five-minute walk of the nearest station, and add value by including IoT-compatible equipment as standard. Tasuki Co., Ltd. develops compact low- to mid-rise residences targeting plots of approximately 60 m² to 200 m², while Shinnihon Tatemono Co., Ltd. develops mid- to high-rise residences targeting plots of approximately 150 m² to 500 m²; in the same areas, the two develop residences of different sizes and specifications. In the Finance Consulting Business, drawing on real estate appraisal know-how accumulated by the group as a real estate developer, it flexibly responds to lending to businesses that other companies find difficult to appraise.

entries.7e31ed7f6870c47d: This business is carried out by Tasuki Co., Ltd., Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd., Aura Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. (unconsolidated). The business plans, develops and sells newly built IoT residences for investment, mainly in Tokyo’s 23 wards; acquires, adds value to and sells used properties for resale (refining properties); plans, develops and sells logistics facilities and similar properties; provides asset consulting for property owners; operates the real estate crowdfunding service “TASUKI FUNDS” and organizes and manages private real estate funds; and acquires, renovates (regenerates), sells and manages vacant houses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥74,211 million.
entries.8ac8a700d6c13e66: Of revenue of ¥74,412 million for the fiscal year ended September 2025, the Life Platform Business accounted for ¥74,211 million and the Finance Consulting Business for ¥193 million, so the Life Platform Business accounts for almost all of revenue. There is no revenue from external customers outside Japan, and no specific customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. The filing states that, in the real estate market in which the group operates, property prices as a whole have remained at high levels, and the investment appetite of domestic and overseas investors for real estate in the Tokyo metropolitan area has remained firm.
